feeds.title: Gourmand Gunno Restaurant Blog
feeds.description: On this website you will find all of Gourmand Gunno's reviews of restaurants in London and across other parts of the UK, dating back to August 2012. The blog is updated regularly, with most recent reviews listed first. It is fully searchable, both by restaurant name and by style of cuisine/ location.

feeds.title: The Nottingham Food Blog
feeds.description: In some ways, My Food Hunt is just what it says. It is the story of my travels looking for and consuming food, some of it good, some of it not so good. This blog is just one part of my life, a big part to be honest, but when I am not munching my way through Nottinghamshire I can be found either cooking at home or traveling far and wide on a MyFoodHunt quest of some sort

feeds.title: Cheese and Biscuits
feeds.description: A place to find hyperbolic, ill-researched but hopefully entertaining reviews of mainly London restaurants.

feeds.title: Yorkshire Food Guide
feeds.description: The Yorkshire Food Guide is a trusted online guide to getting the best out of Yorkshire's dining destinations. Promoting the best in the business all under one umbrella, to inspire foodies on where to eat across the region. Keep up to date with the latest news, reviews, foodie events and exclusive offers.

feeds.title: Major Foodie Blog
feeds.description: Major Foodie, authored by Richard Bagnold, is an esteemed blog delving into the world of gastronomy. With an unwavering commitment to honesty, Richard shares his independent insights on diverse dining experiences, spanning from renowned 3 Michelin-starred venues to welcoming local eateries. The platform serves as a beacon for food enthusiasts seeking genuine and trustworthy restaurant reviews, encapsulating the essence of fine dining for all who share his passion.

feeds.title: The Picky Glutton
feeds.description: I am sPicky Glutton and this is my restaurant reviews blog where I aim to review every restaurant I dine at. With so many places to eat, the last place you want to go is somewhere deeply disappointing or, perhaps even worse, somewhere forgettably mediocre and yawningly average. To help you out, I will endeavour to finish each review with a firm recommendation either way and a rating out of 5.

feeds.title: Restaurants Brighton Blog
feeds.description: Restaurants Brighton is a comprehensive eating guide covering Brighton, Hove, and Sussex. This local guide is here to help visitors and locals find and enjoy great places to eat and drink in Brighton.

feeds.title: Bitten Oxford Blog
feeds.description: Bitten Oxford is your ultimate Oxford food and drinks guide - with restaurant listings, news, events, recommendations and more. Bitten helps you decide where to eat, and also where not to.

feeds.title: Gourmet Gorro
feeds.description: My name is Ed Gilbert. I'm an indiscriminate glutton who enjoys a late-night doner as much as a bit of posh. I like to think I can occasionally share a valid opinion about food when my judgement hasn't been clouded by the meat red mist. I mostly write reviews of restaurants in Cardiff, South Wales.

feeds.title: Frusher on Food
feeds.description: A fully independent delve into the Nottingham food scene, with the odd journey elsewhere thrown in. Alen has been writing about restaurants for 7 years and has eaten at almost 200 restaurants across Nottingham as well as the majority of the country's best.

feeds.title: Elsa Eats
feeds.description: My name is Elsa and I am a Manchester food blogger! I give reviews of restaurants, things you can get at the shops, recipes and interviews with local traders! I like travelling and love desserts, especially cakes!

feeds.title: The Graphic Foodie
feeds.description: Covers reviews and guide to the best restaurants, popups, supper clubs and food news in Brighton & Hove.

feeds.title: Leeds Foodie
feeds.description: My name's Kyle and, as a southerner who has adopted Yorkshire as my home, I have grown to love and live for food in Leeds and Yorkshire. During my twenty-something years on the planet, I've had the amazing opportunity to enjoy food from places as diverse as Madagascar to the fine dining tables of London, via the majestic kitchen that is my Gran's! As you will see in this blog, I like to think of myself as a foodie who can critique but who can also enjoy

feeds.title: London Eater
feeds.description: It is a London food blog and restaurant reviews and restaurant guide and a gastro-centric survival guide for Londoners.

feeds.title: HaraldOnFood.com
feeds.description: I'm Harald, a food critic and food lover in the broadest sense of the word, always searching for culinary delights. I started writing about food in January 2019 when I founded this blog. I write honest reviews, as I experience things as a guest. Reading my reviews, gives you an unbiased view of what you can expect when you would visit the restaurant. My main focus is the food, but I will give my overall opinion and will elaborate on other things when I feel the need to do so.

feeds.title: Halal Girl About Town
feeds.description: Tired of eating the same typical halal food almost 10 years ago, Layla Hassanali made it her mission to find restaurants around London that both catered for halal and offered something a little different. What started as a 'blog' back in 2012 to journal all of the exciting new food and travel finds, HGAT has now evolved to become the UK's biggest halal food and travel platform dedicated to discovering the best halal restaurants in the country, Muslim-friendly travel destinations and more.

feeds.title: Binny's Food & Travel » Restaurant Reviews
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Binny, a London based writer, dreams and a serious wanderlust. I love to write about food, whether it is sharing my recipes, or experiencing dining out in a restaurant, home restaurant, or meal kit.

feeds.title: The Foodaholic » Restaurant Reviews
feeds.description: Restaurant reviews & news from across the UK & Europe. The Foodaholic is a lifestyle blog for the best in luxury food, travel, cuisine, and hotel.

feeds.title: Glasgow Food Geek
feeds.description: Glasgow Food Geek is a food blog based in Scotland. You can expect to find restaurant reviews, recipes, and lots of food love. Glasgow Food Geek is about a west-end girl blogging about being surrounded on every street by amazing restaurants & cafes.

feeds.title: The London Foodie
feeds.description: I'm Luiz. I am a Japanese Brazilian chef who made London home nearly 30 years ago. I am passionate about good food, wine and travel and have been writing as The London Foodie since 2009.

feeds.title: The Bon Vivant Journal
feeds.description: The Bon Vivant Journal focuses on the best restaurants, bars, and hotels in London and beyond. Whether it's the best hotels in New York, my favourite escapes near London, a guide to the hotels and restaurants in Mallorca or a monthly guide to the new restaurants and bars opening in London, I give you my advice, recommendations and tips on the best of the best.

feeds.title: Emily's Recipes and Reviews
feeds.description: Hello. I'm Emily! I'm a 32-year-old North Leicestershire girl. I like to try out new recipes, ingredients and foodie products, review restaurants and explore farmers' markets and food fairs. I've loved collaborating with some of my favourite brands and having featured recipes and reviews online. I also write regular restaurant reviews for my regional newspaper, the Leicester Mercury.

feeds.title: Squidbeak Blog
feeds.description: Squidbeak is all about finding the best places to eat in Yorkshire. We write as we find and report honestly on what we find. We celebrate the best and if a place doesn't come up to scratch, it doesn't get in. We visit anonymously and pay for all the meals we review for Squidbeak.

feeds.title: OpenTable UK Blog
feeds.description: The leading online consumer destination for restaurant bookings in the UK. Get Food & restaurant news from OpenTable UK.

feeds.title: The Infatuation » London
feeds.description: Find the best restaurants in London for everything from Date Night to Late Night Eats. Search hundreds of reviews and guides and never have a mediocre meal again. At The Infatuation our mission is very simple: to bring you the most honest and trustworthy opinions on where to eat around the world.

feeds.title: Curious London
feeds.description: The no-bullshit guide to eating, drinking and doing in the Capital
